Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic, so absorption through the bladder wall or breached mucosa can cause hemolysis and dilutional electrolyte imbalance such as hyponatremia.

Q9030.reason: The son is an intended donee beneficiary whose rights had not vested when the owner and landscaper modified the payee term by paying the father, and the son learned of the contract only afterward.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210, a general bar on assigning 'the contract' is read as barring only delegation, so the right to receive the $30,000 can still be assigned unless the clause specifically says otherwise.
